ideas.pitch: An AI-powered co-pilot that stress-tests startup pitch decks against real-time venture capital investment theses and market validation metrics.
ideas.title: PitchValidator AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeted directly at Startup Street 11's entrepreneurial marathon format, specifically helping teams survive the Shark Tank-style final pitch by stress-testing their market validation before judges poke holes in it.

ideas.pitch: An automated market validation agent that crawls competitor data, synthesizes TAM/SAM/SOM estimates, and generates customer persona interviews using synthetic focus groups.
ideas.title: ValidaMarket
ideas.why_it_could_win: Matches the specific event milestone of Day 1's 'Ideation & Problem Validation' checkpoint, giving teams an immediate workflow tool to complete their business plan faster than manual research.

ideas.pitch: A rapid financial modeling and cap table scenario generator designed for early-stage founders to simulate dilution, seed rounds, and unit economics during a hackathon timeline.
ideas.title: CapTable Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to the business planning and financial rigor that judges look for during Review Round 1 and the Elimination Round.

ideas.pitch: An internal networking and mentor-routing engine for hackathons that matches team skills and startup domains with the exact industry experts available in the room.
ideas.title: MentorMatch AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the friction of the 'Team Formation & Networking' and 'Mentor Checkpoint' phases listed in the event timeline by maximizing founder-mentor connection efficiency.

ideas.pitch: A rapid landing-page generator and waitlist analytics dashboard that equips student founders with instant conversion metrics to prove real-world market interest before the final pitch.
ideas.title: TractionTracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides hard quantitative metrics (conversion rates, sign-ups) which outscore qualitative claims during the Shark Tank-style final pitch judging.
